messages:
jen: Heads up — partner reported sudden latency spikes and intermittent soft OOMs after a driver bump (540.2) landed in their marketplace VM images this morning. They see RT increases ~3x for steady-state inference and a handful of failures that look like driver/kernel handoff issues. Link they shared: https://partner.example.com/incident/1245

akshay: Can you paste the failing stderr/log sample? also which models + batch sizes?

jen: Pasted snippet from partner (redacted):
```
2026-03-20T08:12:14Z inference-worker stderr: cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid device function (err 1)
2026-03-20T08:12:14Z inference-worker stderr: falling back to slower kernel path
2026-03-20T08:12:14Z inference-worker ERROR: KV cache allocation failed: out of memory
```
Batch sizes are small (1-4), model is a CPU+GPU half-precision LLM ~13B. Partner said image uses NVIDIA driver 540.2 with CUDA runtime 12.3 build.

sam: Partner: we confirmed their marketplace VM image has driver 540.2 pinned by the cloud vendor image. They didn't intentionally upgrade; vendor image moved. Hardware side: no electrical issues, looks like a driver ABI/dispatch change.

maria: We started a quick repro in our Canary fleet and see the same kernel dispatch errors on a subset of A100 nodes after reprovisioning with the vendor image. Rough counts: 12/50 runs fail with kernel launch or fallback.

akshay: Preliminary take: recent driver (540.x) has a runtime ABI change that changes kernel selection heuristics for certain compiled kernels. Our runtime falls back but that hits slow paths and memory pressure. Short-term plan: pin marketplace images to last-known-good driver (535.x) and push a hotfix to runtime to add a safer fallback that avoids the heavy memory path.

yuki: Marketplace side — we can add a driver pin and rollback toggle for the affected image tags. We can update image tags within the marketplace config within ~6 hours and enable a rollout hold. Do we want a global rollback or just partner-specific images?

sam: Partner prefers we pin only marketplace image tags used by our joint listing for now (minimize blast radius). They will test pinned 535.102 and report. If green, we can coordinate a gradual unpin later.

akshay: Action items (short):
- akshay: open hotfix branch -> PR base: main, branch: fix/driver-dispatch-fallback; add extra kernel guard + reduced KV allocation path (ETA 24h)
- maria: run nightly regression harness across driver matrix (535, 540) on A100 + H100 nodes and post failures (ETA tonight)
- yuki: update marketplace image pin + add rollback toggle for joint listing (ETA 6h)
- sam: coordinate partner test, get signoff on pinned image, and collect full logs (ETA EOD)

jen: I'm going to draft a short partner-facing update: "We have a targeted mitigation (pin in marketplace) and runtime hotfix in progress; we'll validate with you on pinned image and then merge hotfix if green. No public announcement until verification."

ops-bot: New incident created: INC-2026-284 (driver-compatibility-marketplace). Assigned: eng-runtime, partnerships, marketplace.

maria: I'll kick off the driver matrix nightly now. Tests: small-batch latency, kv-cache pressure, memory footprint, and kernel-fallback regression. Will post raw logs here.

jen: Also — longer-term we should: add driver axis to gating matrix for marketplace listings (drivers 535, 540, 542) and a ROCm axis for our private deployments (rocm 5.6, 5.8). yuki/sam can you weigh in on rollout automation for per-listing pins?

sam: We support adding ROCm 5.8 to our internal matrix; partner doesn't use ROCm but SI integrations might. We'll send a repo of hardware test runs by EOD and a checklist for image vendors (driver ABI check, kernel dispatch smoke tests).

yuki: I'll prototype a per-listing pinning flag and a rollback API in marketplace config. If eng-runtime provides a short test script we can wire it into gating CI.

akshay: I'll include a small smoke test script with `nvidia-smi` + a short kernel dispatch validation and a memory-pressure scenario. Example snippet: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv && ./bin/runtime-smoke --model tiny-13b --batch 1 --iters 10`

jen: Thanks all — let's use this thread for updates. If any partner coms change the timeline, ping me and we'll coordinate announcement timing. :thumbsup:
